{{Quote|He's Baze Joz, only the smoothest mandoviol player in the Outer Rim! I've known Baze a long time, and no matter what anyone tells you, all those rumors are completely false.|[[Blerx Tango]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BT" />}}
'''Baze Joz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] and [[mandoviol]] player in a [[Band/Legends|band]] called the [[Dewback Ramblers]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Our mandoviol player is -- well, he's a wonderful guy, really, but he has kind of an attitude about Imperials. When he arrived here, some Imperial Security Bureau agents questioned him. And he sort of, well, bit one. Now he's on the run out in the desert. Can you bring him here?|Blerx Tango, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BT" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Baze Joz and the Dewback Ramblers operated out of the [[Lucky Star (Mos Entha)|Lucky Star]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:BT" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Baze Joz bit an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] outside of Mos Entha. The [[Band/Legends|band]] leader [[Blerx Tango]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with finding Joz and bringing him back safely. The spacer agreed, but was forced to [[Death/Legends|kill]] three [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] who would not let Joz be escorted.<ref name="SWG:BT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Baze Joz was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, players doing a mission for Blerx Tango had to rescue Baze. Because Baze Joz spawned under the generic "chadra_fan_thief" template, examining him revealed him to be a thief.<ref name="SWG:BT" />
